reply: Phoebe has three distinct moments this week and each wants a different register. Saturday's DUMBO rooftop is the easy pleasure — I'd lean into the Cecilie Bahnsen romance but in a quieter colorway so she doesn't compete with the bride, and swap her Miu Miu ballet flats for the Staud mules so she clears the cobblestones without tipping into formal. For the Condé Nast press day Thursday, the instruction is 'already been working for three hours' — a Sandy Liang cardigan over the Reformation silk cami, high-waist trouser, minimal jewelry. Tuesday's Cecilie Bahnsen resort preview is the trickiest: she needs to read as brand-loyal without looking costumed, so I'm pairing her existing broderie blouse with an editorial trouser and letting the Bottega pouch do the work. Across all three I'm staying inside her resale-first rule — every sourced piece links to Vestiaire or RealReal first, retail only if nothing ships in time.
